description: This file defines the RedisEventSubscriber class responsible for managing Redis pub/sub connections, handling events, and streaming data to clients via SSEStreamer.

classes.name: RedisEventSubscriber
classes.description: A class that manages Redis subscriptions, handles incoming messages, and streams events to clients.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes Redis client based on environment variables, sets up event listeners, and assigns the SSEStreamer instance.

methods.name: setupEventListeners
methods.description: Sets up Redis client event handlers for connect, ready, error, end, and reconnecting events.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a Redis channel and sets up message handling.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Parses incoming Redis messages and streams corresponding events via SSEStreamer.
